chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abi Ayyub, who said: I heard Bukayr ibn A'yan narrating from one of the two of them, peace be upon them, who said:

Whoever commits zina with a woman within the prohibited degrees of kinship until he has intercourse with her is to be struck one blow with the sword, taking from him whatever it takes. And if she had consented to him, she is struck one blow with the sword, taking from her whatever it takes.
It was said to him: Then who carries out the strike against them when they have no claimant? He said: That is upon the Imam, when they are brought before him.

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam as the legitimate authority responsible for executing the ruling
key_terms.تَابَعَتْهُ: she consented to him or went along with him
key_terms.خَصْمٌ: a litigant or claimant in a legal dispute
key_terms.ذَاتِ مَحْرَمٍ: a woman within the prohibited degrees of kinship for marriage
key_terms.زَنَى: committed zina, meaning unlawful sexual intercourse
key_terms.ضَرْبَةً بِالسَّيْفِ: a strike with the sword as the stated punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Shia hadith on zina with a mahram, and who carries out the punishment?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning zina with a mahram and states a severe hadd punishment for the offender, and for the woman as well if she was consenting. It also clarifies that implementation of this punishment belongs to the Imam when the case is brought before him, indicating judicial authority in such matters.
